violation_type.title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))
violation_type.typical_finding: A childs hands were observed to not be washed after a childs diaper was changed.

finding_variants.text: A childs hands were observed to not be washed after a childs diaper was changed.
During the inspection I observed that the child did not  wash their hands after a diaper change.     Corrected:  The child was instructed to wash her hands.
A caregiver did not wash the child's hands after diapering procedures. The staff was addressed by the assistant director to follow proper hand washing procedures.
Two caregivers failed to wash the hands of 4 children after diaper changes.
Diaper changing was observed, however the infants hands were not washed after diaper changing.
The teacher was observed changing several children's diapers without washing their hands.  This was corrected when another teacher washed the hands of the children that had their diaper changed.
